verdict: Good app, but not top-tier yet

framework_idioms.proof: apps/web/src/pages/AnalyticsPage.tsx:63-64 �� named selectors from @tiercade/state. All 6 pages use centralized RTK selectors. createAppStore uses RTK configureStore idiomatically.

credibility.proof: All factory callers consistent (loop 30). createAppStore documents process-lifetime. All hooks tested at Interface. Named RTK selectors (loop 27). DAG enforcement (loop 28). Residual Accounting Pass: 9-anchor met.
credibility.residual_blocking_10: packages/core/src/models.ts:22-31 — Item interface parallel URL fields retained for backward compat
